definitions.explanation: The residence of the Emperor or other members of the imperial family. Most commonly refers to the Kyoto Imperial Palace ({京都御所|きょうとごしょ}), the former main residence of the Emperor before the capital moved to Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}{御所|ごしょ}を{見学|けんがく}した。
examples.english: I visited the Kyoto Imperial Palace.

examples.japanese: {御所|ごしょ}の{周|まわ}りは{緑|みどり}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There is a lot of greenery around the imperial palace.

examples.japanese: かつて{天皇|てんのう}が{住|す}まわれていた{御所|ごしょ}は、{今|いま}では{一般|いっぱん}{公開|こうかい}されている。
examples.english: The imperial palace where the Emperor once lived is now open to the public.

notes:
USAGE:
{御所|ごしょ} specifically refers to the Emperor's residence, while {皇居|こうきょ} is the modern term for the current imperial residence in Tokyo. {京都|きょうと}{御所|ごしょ} is the most common collocation, referring to the historic palace in Kyoto.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {京都|きょうと}{御所|ごしょ}: Kyoto Imperial Palace
- {仙洞|せんとう}{御所|ごしょ}: palace of a retired emperor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {皇居|こうきょ}: Imperial Palace (current Tokyo residence)
- {宮殿|きゅうでん}: palace (general term)
